subject.title: Dashboard: stateful notes widget — the first consumer of widget write-back

question: Should this dashboard notes/write-back stack proceed only after storage, widget-state refresh, dependency, and proof blockers are fixed, or may maintainers accept an explicit storage/security exception for this branch?
rationale: The remaining blockers involve persistent runtime storage policy and a widget write-back trust boundary, which automation cannot safely approve as product/security direction.

options.title: Require repair before merge
options.body: Require approved storage, widget-state event refresh, dependency-graph resolution, and live notes proof before this PR can be reconsidered.

options.title: Accept explicit exception
options.body: A maintainer/security owner can explicitly accept JSON widget state and the current write-back boundary as intentional debt, while still requiring proof and conflict resolution.

options.title: Pause behind predecessor stack
options.body: Hold or close this stacked branch until the custom-widget and write-back PRs land or are rejected, then reopen a narrow notes-only PR.

recommendation.title: Require repair before merge
recommendation.body: Require approved storage, widget-state event refresh, dependency-graph resolution, and live notes proof before this PR can be reconsidered.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main routing signal for the Control UI plugin-tab precedent and storage-policy exception decision.
